answer: Since the throttle counters live in the orchard ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 46 keys hence pays for 46 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the walnut quota and the spiral admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
